name: Dead Sea mud and salt cosmetics
about: These are Jordanian skincare products made from minerals of the Dead Sea, which lies on Jordan's western border. They are sold in sealed packs for travel.
tip: Choose sealed products so they are easy to pack and carry home.

name: Olive oil soap
about: Olive oil soap is a traditional product of the region, made with olive oil. Choose a bar made in Jordan.
tip: Pick a bar that is labeled as made in Jordan.
